description:
Stop scrolling if you've been searching for a 5-bedroom home. 👀

This one checks boxes most buyers can't find in a single house.

✔️ 3 bedrooms downstairs (including the primary suite)
✔️ 2 bedrooms upstairs—one with its own ensuite
✔️ Two oversized living rooms
✔️ Nearly 3,000 square feet
✔️ Corner lot in the Skipcha, Union Grove & Harker Heights High school zones

📍2526 Bargello St., Harker Heights, TX

If your current home feels cramped, this layout might be exactly what you've been waiting for.

Save this video, share it with someone who's house hunting, and message me for a private showing.

#HouseHunting #HarkerHeights #TexasHomes
